description: Annotated traffic-forecasting comparison cases for evaluating Relay against a single-pass baseline.
annotator: Claude (coding agent) from arXiv HTML full text on 26 October 2026; every gold label has a verbatim quote. Not yet reviewed by a domain researcher.

outcomes.comparable: dataset, split, horizon (including single vs averaged), and metric match, and no stated conflict in metric definition
outcomes.incompatible: at least one of these is stated and differs, or a source states that one metric was computed non-standardly
outcomes.insufficient: no stated conflict, but dataset, split, or horizon aggregation is not stated for at least one result

policy.metricDefinition: masked, unmasked, nonstandard, or null when not stated; unknown definitions are caveats, not conflicts
policy.provenance: own, reproduced, cited, or unknown; requires an explicit statement or table legend
policy.evidence: paper text only (arXiv HTML), same for every system; repository evidence is not used in this evaluation
